title: [DEV] Revolt of 1804: a hex strategy game about the Serbian uprising got rated 18+ because of alcohol and musket use, is that normal? (iPhone/iPad)
author: Expensive-Fill-2167
selftext:
Hi all. I'm a solo developer, and this is my game: **Revolt of 1804: Serbia Rises**, a single-player strategy game for iPhone and iPad about the First Serbian Uprising.

[https://apps.apple.com/at/app/revolt-of-1804/id6838113383](https://apps.apple.com/at/app/revolt-of-1804/id6838113383)

In 1804 four renegade janissary chiefs, the dahije, held the Belgrade pashaluk and had killed many of the headmen the villages trusted. The men of Šumadija chose Karađorđe to lead them. You play their rising: win the villages over, raise and arm your bands, and beat the pasha's columns in battle.

**What you do**

* **Win the villages.** Each one leans somewhere from hostile to risen. A loyal village still under the pasha pays you half its taxes in secret. Once it rises it pays them all, and the Ottomans come for it.
* **Fight turn-based hex battles.** Every attack shows its odds and what it may cost you before you commit. Musketeers volley, guns fire canister, and horsemen get down to hold houses on foot.
* **Or don't.** When armies meet you can fight, auto-resolve (it tells you how often your men win), withdraw, or buy the enemy off.
* **Mind the pasha's wrath.** Every blow angers him. Strike too hard and he sends his columns. Bribes cool him down, and waiting only lets his garrisons grow.
* **Officers, muster and trade.** Officers have their own portraits and lift morale, sharpen aim or quicken the march. Buy muskets, horses and iron, and guard your caravans from raiders.

The campaign map runs on a clock, but it stops whenever something needs you (a battle, a caravan, a report), so you never have to rush. The map is drawn from real geography (OpenStreetMap and elevation data) and turns with the seasons. A guide walks you through every screen, and there are two difficulties, Normal and Nightmare.



So far so "normal" - I was shocked in the end to see that my game is rated 18+ due to firearms use and especially due to the "frequent" alcohol use (you can organize feast to replenish the moral of your units). Isn't that a bit wild? There are no gore/blood effects?

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Expensive-Fill-2167 could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.
